portal-glimpse.config.title: Portal Glimpse
portal-glimpse.config.entityOverPanorama: Players in a portal show through it.
portal-glimpse.config.shaderRenderMethod: RTT = shader-lit. Overlay = drawn on top.
portal-glimpse.shaderpack.unsupported: Portal Glimpse: the shaderpack "%s" isn't supported yet — the RTT glimpse has no calibration for it and may look too dark, washed out or blown out. BSL is the recommended pack for now.
portal-glimpse.partial.title: This shaderpack is partially supported
portal-glimpse.partial.line1: The glimpse is colour-matched for this pack, but one thing is off:
portal-glimpse.partial.line3: Everything else works. You can keep using it, or switch packs.
portal-glimpse.config.menuButton.tooltip: Portal shortcut in the pause menu.
portal-glimpse.config.shaderVeil.tooltip: Swirl over the glimpse. Shaders only.
portal-glimpse.unsupported.title: This shaderpack isn't supported yet
portal-glimpse.unsupported.line1: The shader-lit glimpse (RTT) has no calibration for this pack,
portal-glimpse.unsupported.line2: so it may look too dark, washed out or blown out.
portal-glimpse.unsupported.line3: You can suggest this pack to the author to get it supported.
portal-glimpse.unsupported.useOverlay: Use Overlay instead (works on any pack)
portal-glimpse.config.godRayOccluder.too: Stops sun shafts piercing the glimpse.
portal-glimpse.config.rttPrediction.tool: Cancels RTT lag on fast turns. Lower if it wobbles.
portal-glimpse.config.captureRadius.tool: Terrain loaded before capture. Higher = longer wait.
portal-glimpse.preview.dragHint: Drag left / right to look around
